name: Jake's Love Story
source:
Jake's Love Story is an slice-of-life/comedy/romance about a group of friends in high school.
In this short interactive story for everyone play as Jake, a totally average high school student.
Meet cheerful and clumsy Emma, cold and distant Alice, and friendly Mike!

During Jake's school days you will get to make various choices, resulting in a few different story endings. Each of them can have some visual changes, so in the end you can end up in one of many endings! Will you manage to get all of them?

Do school projects, laugh at funny situations, help Jake's friends... or not. Decision is up to you!
Will one of the girls agree to go with Jake to prom? Or maybe both of them? Will the group stay friends?
How does Jake's story end?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/699080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《杰克的恋爱故事》是一部围绕高中朋友们展开的日常喜剧恋爱作品。
在这部适合所有人的短篇互动故事中，扮演普通得不能再普通的高中生杰克。
认识开朗笨拙的艾玛、冷淡疏远的爱丽丝，以及友善的迈克！

在杰克的校园生活中，你将做出各种选择，迎来数个不同故事结局。每个结局还会有视觉变化，最终可能得到许多种结局！你能全部解锁吗？

完成学校作业、对有趣情境发笑、帮助杰克的朋友……也可以不做。决定权在你！
女孩们中有人愿意和杰克一起参加舞会吗？还是两人都愿意？这群朋友会继续保持友谊吗？
杰克的故事将如何结束？

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/699080/]Steam[/url]]
